Why go: long lines through the jungle canopy

This is the longer of the two zipline parks we sell, with real distance on the lines and proper vertical drops. The Golden course is one of the most complete courses on the island: three abseils up to 40 m, sky corridors and spiral staircases between the lines, so it feels like a jungle circuit rather than a few rides.

Guides clip you in and check every transfer, and the gear is Petzl, the same equipment used for rope access and climbing. The Silver course is the right choice for first-timers and children from 7; the Golden course suits anyone who wants two full hours in the trees.

Which course? Silver covers about 2,000 m of line with two abseils, which is plenty for most families. Golden more than doubles the line to about 5,000 m and adds a 40 m abseil, so pick it if you have done ziplines before or want the longest run on the island.

Who it suits

  • Families with children aged 7 and over.
  • Groups of friends who want a half-day activity away from the beach.
  • Anyone who wants more line and height than the shorter canopy courses offer.

Who should choose something else

  • Children under 7 or anyone over 100 kg.
  • Guests short on time: the shorter west-coast canopy zipline takes about 2.5 hours in total.
  • Anyone who prefers engines to harnesses: see the ATV and buggy jungle tour.

Good to know

  • Safety: listen to the briefing, keep hands off the trolley and brake only as shown. Guides decide if a guest is not fit to continue.
  • Weather: courses run in light rain and close during lightning. The wettest months are October to December.
  • Mornings are cooler: the standard 08:00 pickup avoids the midday heat.
  • Booking: online booking for tomorrow closes at midnight Thai time.
